name: Fool for You
source:
Uh oh! The queen must marry and secure an heir, but finding a king in the streets is an easy as finding her fool in her sheets.

[From [url=https://heartsickhaven.itch.io/fool-for-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
糟了！女王得结婚，好确保王位后继有人。要在街上找到个国王，倒跟在她的床单底下找到她的弄臣一样容易。
